name: cenk-overtime
description: The cenk-overtime plugin, shared from this folder: help for employees claiming unpaid overtime or extra shifts.

plugins.name: cenk-overtime
plugins.description: For employees who worked unpaid overtime or extra shifts and want to claim it from their employer, alone or with a lawyer: a case folder in your own Google Drive to share with your lawyer, your overtime hours counted from your own work traces (weekday and weekend apart), and a court-ready report. Not legal advice.
